scores.evidence: Each of the 3 objectives is still assessed (o1: q0–q2, e1, e2; o2: q3, e3, e4; o3: q4, e5, e6). The e4 change only rewords the prompt: it keeps objectiveId o2, bloom apply, the same options and the answer ["a"]. The writing in o2 (「書ける」) and the design in o3 (「設計できる」) are still produced only in the practice sections, which have self-checks (p1-checklist, p2-checklist). The exam only asks the learner to select.

hook-b1 is a concrete scene in 3 sentences (「機能の実装を任せている途中で、急ぎのバグ修正を頼まれました…「毎晩、テストの失敗を報告してほしい」」) that sets up both halves of the lesson. The ungraded predict q0 targets the same-folder misconception, every wrong option has feedback, and the answer is the third option.

The three new glosses sit at each term's first use in the file: s1-table 「依存パッケージ（package）を入れ直し」, s3-mode 「5つのフラグ（flag）で安全にしています」 (the first フラグ in the lesson; the next is s3-table) and e4 「手元にクローン（clone）しました」 (the only クローン). The earlier support is unchanged: the prerequisites and recall (「第7回の[[サブエージェント]]」, 「Manualモード（第2回）」), s1-defs, s4-defs, and glosses for トークン, シェル, CI, PR and API.

measure.mjs: 「prose 2262 (budget 1,200–2,400) · read 2650 · practice reading 1246 · questions 11 · practice sections 2 · est 20.0 min (must be ≤ 20; estMinutes 20)」. The trims in s1-lead, s4-lead, s4-enforce and ex-merge offset the three glosses (prose 2265 → 2262), but est stays exactly at the cap. lint --strict reports 0 warnings. headless is still dense: 非対話的実行, シェル and four new flags (s3-table) in one segment. unattended-where still adds 2 terms that are never practiced.

Each practice task comes after a worked example. s2-steps keeps 5 subgoal-labelled steps, and each gives its reason. The trimmed ex-merge still does: 「セッションを終えるときは、ワークツリーを残します。消すとブランチも消えます。」. s3-code with s3-table explains each flag, and s4-prompt maps a model prompt to the 4 points in its expect. No faded example comes between these and practice, and p1-model is almost the same as s3-code.

Four of the five segments still end with an inline check that applies the idea to a new case (q1, q2, q3, q4), each with a hint and per-option feedback. The rewritten e4 prompt (「よく知らない公開リポジトリを、手元にクローン（clone）しました。中身を確かめる前に `claude -p` で要約させたいとします。」) adds no cue to the key: 「中身を確かめる前に」 was already in the earlier version, and the options and feedback are unchanged. e3 and e5 still balance every flag and clause across 2 options each.

The 7 misconceptions in the brief are still covered: broad `Bash` and `bypassPermissions` (e3 b, d), a missing `--bare` (e3 c, d; e4 d 「`-p` は信頼の確認を出しません。」), and a quiet day vs a failed read (q4 d, e5 b, e5 d). s4-enforce still corrects the belief that a prompt line is enforced: 「依頼文の「編集しない」は、CLAUDE.mdと同じく強制になりません。」.

There are no images and no decoration. The comparisons in s1-table, s3-table and s4-table are 「〜なら、…」 lists, a defensible choice for mobile. The worktree layout (main folder, `.claude/worktrees/<名前>/`, branch `worktree-<名前>`) is spatial and is described only in text (ex-feature expect); a small diagram would help.

Both tasks are hands-on, with expect, a hint → troubleshoot ladder, a model answer (p1-model, p2-prompt expect) and a checklist (7 and 4 items). p-run also asks for a prediction first. The second task is not a transfer task: p2-before is the same nightly-test scenario as practice 1, and its model answer repeats p1-model's prompt.

summary-points (4 points) comes after the exam and matches the four key ideas. summary-next gives a reflection task (「成功の条件を1文で書いてみましょう」) and the next lesson. There are 7 retrieval flashcards, and summary-ask offers 3 askTutor suggestions.

The trims keep the claims and their citations: ex-merge (「消すとブランチも消えます」, s2-steps cites cc-worktrees), s4-enforce (「CLAUDE.mdと同じく強制になりません。権限と費用の上限は、フラグや設定で守らせます。」, cites cc-headless), and s3-mode still cites cc-headless and cc-permission-modes. No new claim was added. The section title 「並列の3つの方法」 still counts methods, which the docs do not support. It now sits next to s1-lead 「並列の道具を2つ紹介します」 (niceToHave).

The changed text keeps です・ます and a neutral tone (「夜間のチェックなど、無人で回したい作業があります。」, 「並列の道具を2つ紹介します。」). The glosses follow the course's 「カタカナ（English）」 pattern. The terminology split from earlier rounds is unchanged: 「承認が要る」 in s3-mode and q3 vs 「確認が要る」 in s3-table, e3 and pc-mode, and 「練習用リポジトリ」 in s2-code vs 「練習用フォルダー」 in p1-task.

The only declared locale (jp) is complete, and no text is baked into images. The link text is descriptive (「公式ドキュメント（非対話的実行）」), and the plain-text fields (checklist labels, askTutor) contain no markdown.

niceToHave: s4-enforce (changed): the trim removed 「もよい指示ですが」, so the sentence now reads only as 「依頼文の「編集しない」は…強制になりません」. A learner may decide the prompt line is pointless, yet s4-prompt and the e5 key both keep 「編集はしない」. To restore the 'write it, and also enforce it' point in about the same length: 「依頼文の「編集しない」も書きますが、強制にはなりません。」 (the ja-editor decides the wording).
s1-lead (changed): 「並列の道具を2つ紹介します」 now sits right under the unchanged section title 「1. 並列の3つの方法を選び分ける」, so the 2-vs-3 mismatch is easier to see. Suggested title: 「1. 作業に合わせて並べ方を選ぶ」.
check-quiz e3/e5: the feedback only diagnoses. Where length allows, add the corrective step, e.g. e3 b 「`Bash` は全コマンドを通し、`bypassPermissions` は確認を飛ばします。`Bash(npm test *)` と `dontAsk` に絞ります。」.

Still open: p2-before reuses the nightly-test task from practice 1, so it is not a transfer task. Consider a log-summary task (「毎朝ログを見て、エラーをいい感じにまとめておいて。原因がわかったら直しておいて。」) and update the model answer in the p2-prompt expect to match.
Still open: the p2-prompt variable should be 「直した依頼文とコマンド」 so Claude can check `--max-budget-usd` and the permission flags.
Still open: s3-code line 2 → `  "npm run lint の警告を数えてください。" \`; q3 option a → 「`npm test` が実行されないまま終わり、テスト結果のない要約が返る」.
Still open: unattended-where (s4-table) is neither assessed nor practiced. Add one inline item or shorten it to one sentence.
Still open: a 4–5 node worktree diagram with caption and alt would support s2-steps.
Load is still at the cap (measure.mjs est 20.0, estMinutes 20). Any addition needs a matching cut.
summary: This is a verification round. review-scope.mjs exited 0: 7 of 42 blocks changed (9% of the parts), with no change to sections or objectives. The previous review had no open must-fix items, so `resolved` is empty. validate reports 0 errors and lint --strict 0 warnings. measure.mjs gives prose 2262 and est 20.0 (estMinutes 20), still at the cap. I reviewed every changed block in full. The three glosses (依存パッケージ（package）, フラグ（flag）, クローン（clone）) sit at each term's first use. The e4 prompt rewrite keeps the same options, answer and objective and adds no cue to the key. The trims in s1-lead, s4-lead and ex-merge keep their meaning. The s4-enforce trim drops the note that 「編集しない」 is still worth writing. It is not wrong and s4-prompt shows the line kept, so it goes to niceToHave. The changes raise no new must-fix and cause no regression. Every criterion is 3 or higher, and the mean is 3.38.
